About & credits

World Map Guesser is a set of free geography quizzes: maps, flags, shapes and border puzzles.

Credits

  • Maps, country and state outlines, and borders: Natural Earth (public domain).
  • US state flags: drawings from Wikimedia Commons, public domain (Mississippi's is marked “copyrighted free use”, which allows any use).
  • Country flags: country-flags by Hampus Borgos, drawn from Wikimedia Commons (public domain).

Borders and names

Borders follow Natural Earth's default view and aren't a statement on any dispute. Most countries accept their common alternative names (Czechia or Czech Republic, Ivory Coast or Côte d'Ivoire, and so on).

Privacy

No accounts, no cookies and no tracking. Your scores, stats and records are saved only in your own browser (local storage), so clearing your browser data resets them.
